name: confirmation
quote: That's just what thought it would do.
description: Verifying that one's inner prediction model aligns with what's perceived.

variations.name: confirmation of something positive
variations.description: Verifying that an expectation about something positive has occured.
examples: getting the birthday present you'd hoped for

variations.name: confirmation of something negative
variations.description: Verifying that an expectation about something negative has occured.
examples: the sniffle turned into a flu

comparisons.description: When working through something unknown, confirming an understanding of one part is progress, but you may not be certain about the outcome until all pieces are seen clearly.

commentaries.quote: We are pattern machines, and we enjoy confirming patterns both new and old, even if the pattern itself is negative. For example, if your habit is that you can't sleep at night until X happens, it may mostly frustrate you, but part of your brain gets a little boost from confirming the pattern.

conditions: Verifying that one's inner prediction model aligns with what's perceived.
